policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: models come to Google Cloud
items.summary: O and Google Cloud announced frontier models and Codex workflows coming to Google Cloud Marketplace. This expands distribution channels for model/API usage and could broaden enterprise adoption and partner-led deployments.

items.headline: O: Patch the Planet security coordination
items.summary: O described “Patch the Planet” efforts where agents/researchers uncover critical vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation. Material for risk-reputation and indicates ongoing model-assisted security research and program operationalization.

items.headline: V: W-7 PROTAC microgravity experiment launched
items.summary: V’s W-7 mission page says it launched a PROTAC cancer medicine to test whether microgravity yields crystal forms with improved solubility. Supports in-space manufacturing/R&D track for harder-to-formulate therapeutics.

items.headline: GPT-6 + Intelligent UI roll out
items.summary: O began globally rolling out GPT-6 in ChatGPT with “Intelligent UI,” combining text, visuals, and interactive elements. Update also supports partial answers and tool use during generation, expanding product capability surface.

items.headline: V: W-9 launched with dual-vehicle mission
items.summary: V’s W-9 mission page states launch status and describes operating two vehicles on the same launch vehicle to “normalize” reentry cadence/low cost per mission; includes payload partners context.
